# Settings

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_tooltips_json.py from docs/tooltips.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every setting in the Settings dialog of GridPlayer Alabaster 0.2beta_rc1, page by page, in the order the dialog shows them: 163 settings in all. Tooltip is the text shown when you point at the setting. Key is the name in `settings.ini`. Where each value is kept is in the [full settings reference](settings-reference.md) and [Where things are stored](storage.md).

Settings marked *0.2beta* are new in the 0.2beta branch.

| yt-dlp: Allow JavaScript engines found on PATH | Off |  | Also use node, qjs and bun, and look on PATH, in the data folder, Homebrew and the installers' home folders. | yt-dlp: External yt-dlp | (empty) |  | yt-dlp program that resolves links: a full path, or just yt-dlp to use the one on PATH (for example from winget install yt-dlp.yt-dlp or brew install yt-dlp; you keep it updated). | Resolver priority patterns | (empty) |  | *A table of URL patterns (wildcard host, wildcard URL or regex) and the resolver each one picks.* | `streaming/resolver_priority_patterns` |

## Streaming: SponsorBlock

Every YouTube video you play is checked on SponsorBlock, where viewers mark sponsors, self-promotion and similar segments. Only a short prefix of a hash of the video's ID is sent.Segments from SponsorBlock, under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

| Setting | Default | Range or choices | Tooltip | Key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| Categories: Unpaid/Self Promotion | Show in seek bar | Skip, Show in seek bar, Disabled | *Enabled while Use SponsorBlock on YouTube videos is on.* | `sponsorblock/selfpromo` |
| Categories: Interaction Reminder | Show in seek bar | Skip, Show in seek bar, Disabled | *Enabled while Use SponsorBlock on YouTube videos is on.* | `sponsorblock/interaction` |
| Categories: Intermission/Intro Animation | Disabled | Skip, Show in seek bar, Disabled | *Enabled while Use SponsorBlock on YouTube videos is on.* | `sponsorblock/intro` |
| Categories: Endcards/Credits | Disabled | Skip, Show in seek bar, Disabled | *Enabled while Use SponsorBlock on YouTube videos is on.* | `sponsorblock/outro` |
| Categories: Preview/Recap | Disabled | Skip, Show in seek bar, Disabled | *Enabled while Use SponsorBlock on YouTube videos is on.* | `sponsorblock/preview` |
| Categories: Hook/Greetings | Disabled | Skip, Show in seek bar, Disabled | *Enabled while Use SponsorBlock on YouTube videos is on.* | `sponsorblock/hook` |
| Categories: Filler Tangent | Disabled | Skip, Show in seek bar, Disabled | *Enabled while Use SponsorBlock on YouTube videos is on.* | `sponsorblock/filler` |

## Streaming: Network

These settings apply to http and https links. Other links, such as rtsp and rtmp, are opened by the player itself, and only the user agent applies to them.

| Setting | Default | Range or choices | Tooltip | Key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Proxy | System | System, None, Custom | System: use your computer's proxy settings.<br>None: connect directly.<br>Custom: use the proxy address you enter. | `network/proxy_mode` |
| Proxy: Proxy address | (empty) |  | *Enabled while Proxy is Custom.* | `network/proxy_url` |
| Connection: Request timeout | 0 sec | 0 to 600 sec | How long to wait for a site to answer while opening a link. Doesn't affect playback. Auto (0) leaves each library its own default.<br>*The lowest value is shown as Auto.* | `network/timeout` |
| Connection: User agent | (empty) |  | How the player identifies itself to sites. Leave empty for the default. | `network/user_agent` |
| Connection: Force IPv4 | Off |  | Connect over IPv4 only. Try this if links stall or a site blocks your IPv6 address. | `network/force_ipv4` |
| Security: Verify TLS certificates | On |  | Turn this off only for a proxy that signs traffic with its own certificate. | `network/verify_tls` |
| Security: Allow http links in https playlists | On |  | Some streams have an https playlist that links to http video. Turn this off to block those links. | `network/allow_http_in_playlists` |

## Plugins: SubtitleCat.com

Alabaster has no SubtitleCat.com account. Sign up and sign in in your browser. Search, download and translate use that browser's subtitlecat.com cookies for one request and do not save them.

| Setting | Default | Range or choices | Tooltip | Key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Enable SubtitleCat.com | Off |  | Adds Find subtitles on SubtitleCat.com to a cell's Subtitles menu. | `plugins/subtitlecat` |
| Request translations | Off |  | Lets the SubtitleCat.com window ask the site to translate a subtitle. One request per click, never retried; the site's reply, a limit or VIP message too, is shown as sent. Needs SubtitleCat.com enabled.<br>*Enabled while Enable SubtitleCat.com is on.* | `plugins/subtitlecat_translate` |

## Advanced: Video Decoder

| Setting | Default | Range or choices | Tooltip | Key |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Video Decoder: Decoder | Hardware | Hardware, Hardware SP, Software, Software SP, Dummy | Hardware decodes on the GPU, Software on the CPU. SP (single process) plays every video in the player's own process; the others spread videos over VLC processes. Dummy plays nothing. Videos reload when changed.<br>*On macOS the default is Hardware SP and Hardware is not offered. Where hardware video can't run (Wayland without Xwayland), the Software twin is used and the reason is added to the tooltip.* | `player/video_driver` |
| Video Decoder: Videos per process | 4 | 1 to 64 | How many videos share one VLC process, for Hardware and Software.<br>*Enabled while Decoder is Software, Hardware.* | `player/video_driver_players` |
| VLC Options | (empty) |  | Extra VLC command-line options for every video. Options that open a server, stream out or turn on Lua are dropped. Videos reload when changed.<br>*Written as on the VLC command line, for example --network-caching=1000.* | `misc/vlc_options` |
| Experimental: Opaque overlay (fix black screen) (linux only) | Off |  | *Greyed out where hardware video can't run.* | `internal/opaque_hw_overlay` |
| Experimental: Fake overlay invisibility (fix overlay on top of other windows) (linux only) | Off |  | *Greyed out where hardware video can't run.* | `internal/fake_overlay_invisibility` |
| Experimental: Force native drag-n-drop for in-window drag (linux only) | Off |  |  | `internal/force_native_drag_events` |
| Experimental: HW video border fix | Auto | Auto, Disabled, 2 px, 4 px, 6 px, 8 px, 10 px, 12 px | Crops a few pixels off the edges to hide glitches from hardware video. Auto uses the default for your system.<br>*Greyed out where hardware video can't run.* | `internal/hw_crop_border_offset` |

| Log file: Limit log file size | Off |  | Start a new log file when it reaches the size below, keeping that many old ones. Takes effect after a restart. | `logging/log_limit` |
| Log file: Log file size | 10 MB | 1 to 1048576 MB | *Enabled while Limit log file size is on. Takes effect after a restart.* | `logging/log_limit_size` |
| Log file: Log files to keep | 1 | 1 to 1000 | *Enabled while Limit log file size is on. Takes effect after a restart.* | `logging/log_limit_backups` |
